name: Initialize project structure
done_when: cd frontend && npm run dev shows Astro running; cd backend && go build ./cmd/server succeeds

name: Implement whisper.cpp integration
done_when: cd backend && go test ./internal/transcribe/... passes with whisper.cpp transcription test

name: Basic file upload UI
done_when: Open localhost:3000, select a file, submit form; browser network tab shows multipart POST to backend

name: Basic transcription endpoint
done_when: curl -F 'file=@test.mp3' localhost:8080/api/transcribe returns SRT content

name: Database setup
done_when: cd backend && go run ./cmd/migrate creates subtitler.db with users and jobs tables

name: Email and password authentication
done_when: curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/register -d '{"email":"test@test.com","password":"pass"}' returns 200; subsequent login returns session token

name: User dashboard
done_when: Login as user, navigate to /dashboard, see list of past jobs with download links

name: Background job queue
done_when: Upload file, check /api/jobs shows pending status; wait for worker, status changes to complete

name: Multiple output formats
done_when: curl localhost:8080/api/transcribe?format=vtt returns VTT; format=embedded returns video file with subtitles

name: Job status and notifications
done_when: Upload file, dashboard shows progress updating; email received when job completes

name: Cloudflare Tunnel setup
done_when: curl https://subtitler.yourdomain.com/api/health returns 200 via tunnel

name: CI/CD pipeline
done_when: git push to trunk triggers GitHub webhook; new version deploys automatically

name: Secrets management
done_when: sops -d secrets.enc.yaml outputs decrypted secrets; deployment uses decrypted values

name: Create MARKETING_PLAN.md
done_when: cat MARKETING_PLAN.md shows content creator outreach strategy with target platforms

name: Create EXPERIMENTATION_PLAN.md
done_when: cat EXPERIMENTATION_PLAN.md shows A/B testing framework with metrics for success

name: Analytics integration
done_when: Upload and download file; analytics endpoint or dashboard shows corresponding events

name: Add /api proxy to astro frontend
done_when: All backend API calls are routed to the frontend and proxied to the backend

name: Add rate limiting middleware
done_when: curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/register with 100 rapid requests returns 429 Too Many Requests after configured threshold

name: Add file cleanup job
done_when: Old job files (>30 days) are automatically deleted to save disk space

name: Add usage dashboard for admin
done_when: Admin can view /admin/analytics showing total users, jobs, storage used, and conversion funnels

name: Add language selection for transcription
done_when: Upload form includes language dropdown; transcription uses selected language model

name: Add batch processing
done_when: User can upload multiple files at once; dashboard shows all job statuses

name: CRITICAL: Add login/register UI pages
done_when: Visit /login shows login form; visit /register shows registration form; successful login redirects to /dashboard; homepage shows Login/Register links when logged out and Dashboard link when logged in
note: BLOCKING: Users cannot access authenticated features without this. Backend auth exists but frontend UI was never built. This was planned in 006_DASHBOARD.md but skipped.

name: CRITICAL: Add navigation header component
done_when: All pages include Nav component showing: logo, Login/Register links when logged out, Dashboard/Logout when logged in; navigation is consistent across all pages
note: BLOCKING: Users have no way to navigate between pages. Must be done alongside Task 23.

name: CRITICAL: Fix auth library endpoint paths
done_when: frontend/src/lib/auth.ts uses /api/register, /api/login, /api/logout, /api/me instead of /api/auth/* paths; login and register pages work correctly
note: BLOCKING: Auth library has wrong API paths - will fail when login/register pages are built.

name: HIGH: Enable secure cookies for production
done_when: Cookie Secure flag is true when HTTPS is enabled; configurable via environment variable; documented in deployment guide
note: SECURITY: Current cookies vulnerable to MITM attacks in production.

name: Add 404 and error pages
done_when: Visiting /nonexistent shows styled 404 page matching site design; server errors show friendly error page

name: Add .env.example files for deployment
done_when: backend/.env.example and frontend/.env.example exist with all required variables documented; deployment README references these files

name: Fix backend crash on whisper-server startup failure
done_when: Backend starts successfully even when whisper-server is unavailable; transcription returns appropriate error; go test ./... -short passes
